parameters.help_en:
The custom labels. You can add up to 10 labels with a total length of no more than 1024 characters. The format requirements are as follows:
Labels support only underscores (_) and hyphens (-). Other special characters are not supported.
Separate multiple labels with commas (,)

自定义标签，最多可以添加10个标签，总长度不超过1024个字符，具体格式要求如下：
标签中仅支持下划线（_）和连字符（-），不支持其他特殊字符。
标签之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: labels
